Julia side is isdefined() on the loaded GLLVModels module at the branch head. Not a numeric-output comparison (see P0 runner.tier1_followup, still unbuilt).
row_verdicts_note: An executable row passes only if R registers and defines it at P1 AND the Julia symbol is exported and a Function (measured). Rows that fail are recorded as failures in results.tsv and their case receipts; the verifier accepts the batch when every recorded verdict equals the one recomputed from the facts, not only when every row passes.

Use animal_indep() for standalone marginal diagonal animal-model terms ... use animal_latent(..., unique = TRUE) when the folded latent term itself should carry this diagonal companion.' categorical() (R/missing-predictor.R:143) is a formula-grammar sentinel marking a predictor's imputation type at parse time; it carries no independent Julia numeric surface of its own.

check_auto_residual(fit) (check-auto-residual.R:60) reads fit$tmb_data$family_id_vec and fit$tmb_data$trait_id -- metadata already built by the fitting call -- and checks for within-trait family mixing / ordinal-family conflicts, returning a status/messages list. It computes no numeric quantity of its own (no likelihood, no covariance, no residual value); it is a pure R-side consistency validator over fields the fit already carries, so there is no independent Julia surface to compare against.

compare_Sigma_table operates on already-extracted R objects and compares two already-extracted Sigma tables; it is a comparison/diagnostic utility, not itself a fitted-model accessor with an independent Julia numeric surface.

compare_dep_vs_two_psi operates on already-extracted R objects and cross-checks the dep vs. two-psi covariance parameterizations against each other (an R-internal consistency check between two R parameterizations); it is a comparison/diagnostic utility, not itself a fitted-model accessor with an independent Julia numeric surface.

compare_indep_vs_two_psi operates on already-extracted R objects and cross-checks the indep vs. two-psi covariance parameterizations against each other; it is a comparison/diagnostic utility, not itself a fitted-model accessor with an independent Julia numeric surface.

compare_loadings operates on already-extracted R objects and compares two already-extracted loadings matrices (Lambda_a, Lambda_b) generically; it is a comparison/diagnostic utility, not itself a fitted-model accessor with an independent Julia numeric surface.

confirmatory_lambda(species, group, d, loads_on, ...) (confirmatory-lambda.R:72) is pure R-side construction: it validates its arguments and builds an n x d NA/0 fixed-zero pattern matrix from the loads_on group->axis mapping, with no call into a fit or the TMB/Julia engine. It is the same class of R-only helper as suggest_lambda_constraint(s) (already compatibility_adapter in this manifest): a specification/advisory object with no numeric quantity to compare against a Julia surface.

cumulative_logit() (R/missing-predictor.R:104) is a formula-grammar link-name sentinel used when parsing ordinal formulas; the underlying cumulative-logit likelihood is already required_core via the Ordinal family plan (GLLVM.jl families/ordinal.jl), so this sentinel constructor has no independent numeric content.
